title: Find the permit office for a job

steps.caption: Pipeline
steps.narration: A project can show you the official permit office for the place the job is in.

steps.caption: The card
steps.narration: Find the job on the Pipeline board. We'll use the Oyelaran kitchen.

steps.caption: Open the project
steps.narration: Click its name to open the project.

steps.caption: Matched on
steps.narration: Matched on shows the place the job was matched to. This job is in Albany.

steps.caption: The portal
steps.narration: Under it is the official permit portal on file for that place.

steps.caption: Last checked
steps.narration: A note shows when a link was last checked.

steps.caption: Open portal
steps.narration: Open portal, on the right, takes you to that office's own website.

steps.caption: No guessed links
steps.narration: When no official portal is on file for a place, the tab says so.

steps.caption: No guessed links
steps.narration: It never shows a guessed link.

steps.caption: Menu: Pipeline
steps.narration: Open any job from Pipeline, in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to find the permit office for a job | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of the Permits tab in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will open a project and see the official permit portal on file for the place the job is in, with the date its link was last checked.
